message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I couldn't help but feel a little smug as I pulled out my trusty lantern and power bank. While my friends were scrambling for batteries and candles (yikes!), I was cozy in my living room, basking in the warm glow of my lantern and fully charged phone. It was one of those moments where being prepared felt like winning the lottery! Have you ever had a 'I told you so' moment during an outage? What are your go-to tips for staying comfy when the lights go out? 😊
